authored.title: اليوم الذي
authored.explanation_ar: نحدد زمن حدث باستخدام when في جملة وصل؛ يمكن أحيانًا حذف when بعد كلمات الزمن مثل day.
authored.explanation_en: Use when in a relative clause to describe a particular day or time.
authored.contrast_ar: The day when we met زمن؛ The place where we met مكان.
authored.contrast_en: Day when identifies an event's time; place where identifies its location. Related time nouns such as year are possible in the wider construction.

authored.source_form: If I were + imaginary situation, I would + base verb
authored.form: If I were + imaginary situation, I would + base verb
authored.title: لو كنت
authored.explanation_ar: نستخدم الشرط الافتراضي للتخيل غير الواقعي أو غير المرجح في الحاضر؛ يجوز were مع I في الأسلوب القياسي الافتراضي.
authored.explanation_en: Use if I were for an imagined present situation, followed by would and a base verb for its result.
authored.contrast_ar: If I were a teacher, I would help خيال؛ If I am late, I'll call احتمال واقعي.
authored.contrast_en: If I were ... I would ... imagines a present situation; If I am ... I'll ... can describe a real future possibility.
